scenario_name: 3 omitted dimensions; intended use: Play space / Baby parking (Centro di custodia oraria); vague first answer on Cp
initial_query: I am looking for an existing commercial unit. I need a property with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 15 people. I prefer a property in energy class D or better.
submitted_query: I am looking for an existing commercial unit. I need a property with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 15 people. I prefer a property in energy class D or better.
final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type IN ('Commercial activities and similar', 'Offices and similar')
  AND surface_area >= 109.71
  AND cadastral_units_count >= 10
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
ORDER BY
  id ASC
